# core:json_value

Dynamically-typed JSON value type.

Represents any JSON value: null, boolean, number (as f64), string,
array, or object. Implements `Serialize` and `Deserialize` so it
works transparently with `core:json`'s `to_string` / `from_string`.

Usage:
use { Value } from "core:json_value";
use { to_string, from_string } from "core:json";

let v = from_string::<Value>(`{"x": 1, "y": [true, null]}`);
let s = to_string::<Value>(&v);

## Variants

### `pub variant Value`

A dynamically-typed JSON value, analogous to serde_json::Value.
